items.title: Expedia CEO explains how AI is a 'force multiplier' at every step of its business

items.title: Google Warns EU Regulations Will Reduce Search Quality
items.summary: Google on Tuesday rolled out changes to its online search results in Europe to satisfy EU antitrust regulators, but said the change will degrade user experiences that could cost businesses in time and money.

items.title: Google degrades E.U. search results to comply with DMA rules
items.summary: The company called the changes the largest quality reduction in its 29-year search history, saying they favor intermediaries over local businesses
